'''Eksoan''' was a technology manufacturing company. They developed and manufactured [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] for heavy weapons, including the [[Class-4T3 power generator/Legends|Class-4T3 power generator]] that was used with the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
